newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spreads contained pre-FOMC.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads contained pre-FOMC.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads showed a minor widening against U.S. and Canadian debt, but were outperformed by New Zealand.

Traders said such was the thinness of activity ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting that there was little to read into the trading action between Australia and North American bond markets.

However, N.Z. bonds rallied on the back aggressive buying by one bank, and in response to a NZ$100 million Eurobond issue on Monday, and saw the 10-year premium over Australia narrow to its lowest level in nearly two-weeks.
The Australia/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread continues to find resistance at around 110 basis points after its brief flurry to 106 last week.
All markets will be focussed on the FOMC later today where the Fed could endorse a 25 basis point hike in the Fed Funds rate, which would be the first tightening in some 1-1/2 years.
